descriptions.zh-Hans: 在多伦多吃过 peameal bacon 三明治后自画的小菜单。
descriptions.en: A homemade Toronto peameal bacon sandwich menu with a filling label.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 信使在多伦多把挞和盘子分开标好的菜单纸。
descriptions.en: A Toronto menu labeling tart and plate as separate circles.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 在 CN Tower 看多伦多时画的个人便签，旁边预留第二页。
descriptions.en: A personal CN Tower view note leaving room for a second page.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 信使在多伦多吃挞后制作的原创圆圈纸。
descriptions.en: An original circle slip made after a butter tart in Toronto.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 圣劳伦斯市场歇步后记下招呼的自制纸条。
descriptions.en: A homemade greeting slip after a pause at St. Lawrence Market.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 信使折纸套连起多伦多景色和“家”字的两页卡。
descriptions.en: A paper sleeve joining the messenger’s Toronto view and a page marked home.
